description: Surface Optimization of the (110) Surface of beta-MnO2 (Rutile, P4_2/mnm) and Surface Energy Calculation
user_prompt: Optimize the (110) surface of beta-MnO2 (rutile structure, P4_2/mnm) and calculate the surface energy. Report the final surface energy in J/m^2.

references: Tompsett, Parker & Islam, J. Am. Chem. Soc. 136, 1418 (2014)
Oxford & Chaka, J. Phys. Chem. C 115, 16992 (2011)
Kitchaev et al., Phys. Rev. B 93, 045132 (2016)
method.modeling: Rutile beta-MnO2 (P4_2/mnm); symmetric (110) slab, vacuum > 20 A, ionic positions relaxed.
method.rationale: Value 0.62 J/m^2 is the relaxed PBE+U beta-MnO2(110) surface energy from Tompsett et al. 2014. Oxford & Chaka 2011 give 0.83 J/m^2 for the same facet at plain PBE-GGA (no Hubbard U). The tolerance is +/-0.20 J/m^2. beta-MnO2's true magnetic structure is an incommensurate spiral; DFT surface studies use a collinear high-spin Mn^4+ approximation, so ISPIN=2 is required.
